body:

register_notes: Stage 3 EN education: references prior email + earlier stages (benchmark note); direct close with easy out (release if timing wrong); no figure; 0 question marks; reuses only parent brands (Memrise, Brilliant, Rosetta Stone as quality bar); no sign-off; no em-dash; X-not-Y avoided.
